study.question: Do explicit action-by-match count/freshness statistics add predictive utility to target-match grouped history values beyond either representation alone under matched allocation, redundant-input controls and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed frozen validation AUCs are 0.6050036145 static, 0.6102261137 pooled, 0.6133619861 field-adapted DIN, 0.6186637742 count_freshness and 0.6187998914 match_groups. The latter two differ by only 0.0001361172 and are distinct architectures, so their ordering does not establish complementarity. Group means can lose multiplicity and encode action-conditioned recency indirectly; inherited 4-group x 4-action log counts and conditional mean one-day decay may expose useful residual structure. Test their explicit combination without assuming the representations are independent. First512 parent diagnostics show mean visible length118.12 and 85.16% at limit, making conclusions specific to truncated histories. No current failure/abandoned-branch receipt is exposed, so none is invented; agent-memory searches returned no records. The task narrative mentions other contrasts, but they are not treated as measured evidence without accessible receipts.

nearest_work.difference: DIN describes embedding/pooling/MLP, target-aware learned weighted sums and intentionally unnormalized weights preserving interest intensity. Therefore preserving counts or target-aware history is not claimed novel. This experiment uses deterministic bucket-match group means plus explicit inherited count/freshness blocks, with no learned event scorer execution. The local softmax baseline is field-adapted and not exact DIN.

Author README confirms available behavior fields are category, brand, behavior type and lack item identity. No item-level match or full DMR reproduction is claimed. Publisher full text is unavailable; README evidence cannot establish detailed architectural priority.

Inherit all four disjoint category/brand equality pools and N,C,B,J. Widen the MLP input by32 for explicit statistics or duplicated-global controls. Add occupied-global x evidence factorial; no new raw fields, attention or training objective.

Inherit _evidence exactly: all/category/brand/joint x four actions; log1p(count)/log129 and mean exp(-age/86400), empty cells zero. Replace its learned attention summary with grouped readout in a controlled common head. This is a combination and attribution experiment, not a new invention of either source.

Source reports attention-generated queries, packed multiview retrieval and component ablations in a different pCVR setting. The present observations do not identify a learned-query bottleneck, so no QueryFormer mechanism is adopted and no transfer claim is made.

inherited_components: Frozen host data/scorer/information boundary; static snapshot as-of times remain undocumented.
Incumbent static/action/recency embeddings, dormant attention allocation, four disjoint match pools, N,C,B,J and [128,64] ReLU output MLP.
Exact compact-evidence _evidence source with fixed one-day timescale and log129 scaling.
Prior occupied-global replacement preserves true semantic slot occupancy.
Same host training recipe and scratch initialization; no candidate optimizer or loss override.
study.proposed_difference: Concatenate 16 inherited log-count and16 conditional-freshness values to the incumbent representation. A four-cell 2x2 factorial replaces grouped means by occupied-global means and evidence blocks by repeated global means. Each standalone module differs only in literal CONFIG; all classes and evidence method ASTs are identical. All cells execute true grouping, global summary, C/T reductions and constant-switch arithmetic, so no control saves the evidence computation. The head has32 more inputs, predicted4096 extra dense parameters versus g1 (total17141027; dense62339), to be measured by host. Dormant4226 scorer parameters are allocated but never executed. No global novelty claim; nearest-work coverage beyond inspected sources remains incomplete.
predictions: Predeclared primary screen: F11 must exceed F10 and F01 and both frozen source AUCs; practical target delta>=0.0002 against their maximum. A smaller positive result remains tentative, not a declared scientific success.

Report all AUC/logloss simple effects and the interaction; positive interaction is not necessary for additive complementarity. Prefer a model only with measured cost attached; logloss degradation must remain visible.

Host diagnostics should show zero partition/cardinality/action-count/padding errors up to floating roundoff (pool reconstruction tolerance1e-5); empty evidence and pools exactly zero, finite empty logits, and counts/freshness within[0,1] for valid host ages/action codes. Diagnostics are candidate-supplied first512 checks, not independent full-population validation.

Use the frozen host slices and their sample/positive/negative counts: hour, history length, behavior presence, train-frequency and category match. Explore whether benefit concentrates in long/mixed histories; do not call those slice findings confirmatory or independent samples.

Before repeated validation assessment, freeze the four cell sources/configs/checkpoints, original g0/g1 references and seeds42,43,44. Report paired seed differences and variation; request user-cluster bootstrap only if host provides an authorized interface. No prediction files or bootstrap interface are currently exposed.
falsifiers: F11 fails to exceed either F10 or F01: added complementarity is unsupported even if it beats F00 or baseline DIN.
F11 beats matched arms but not the stronger frozen source: combination may help this implementation, but delivers no demonstrated improvement beyond existing sources.
F10 matches/exceeds F11 and similarly improves over frozen g1: widening, repeated summaries or optimization explains the apparent gain as well as explicit statistics.
Benefits reverse across paired repetitions or the mean advantage falls below the practical target: retain preliminary/inconclusive status. An isolated run cannot establish the mechanism.
Invalid diagnostics, nonfinite outputs or execution failure invalidate that implementation as evidence; retain failed cost and receipt. A failed implementation does not refute the general hypothesis.
Higher wall/allocated GPU time or latency erases a quality-cost benefit: do not claim efficiency from matched parameter counts or fewer scorer operations.
alternative_explanations: Replacement controls match allocation and forward arithmetic, but not effective input rank, feature scale or gradient paths. Repeated global summaries have tied information and may change implicit regularization.
Count/freshness and action/recency embeddings encode overlapping information. A gain supports predictive utility of explicit statistics, not statistical independence or new raw information.
Occupied-global controls retain semantic group occupancy and N,C,B,J; they remove group-conditioned values, not all target-conditioned evidence.
Seed42 and one validation day can support only preliminary model selection. Checkpoint selection and repeated validation search can bias estimates.
Source-specific normalization/scale and hidden-layer optimization may govern the result; explicitly supplied freshness may merely be easier to optimize than recency embeddings.
Truncation at128 discards older counts; snapshot timing, hashed-ID collisions and single-day temporal drift limit transfer.
Accessible history contains only successful initial/frozen source models; unavailable branch outcomes and no scoped agent memory limit trajectory review.
A combined win is predictive evidence only. Counts/freshness decomposition, event identity versus action/time composition, and behavior-level causal explanations need separate future contrasts.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary abstract/introduction and ablation passage inspected. Learned query generation may matter in its source setting, but our near-tied successful compact and grouped models do not identify that bottleneck. Prioritize the observed complementarity uncertainty. Source pCVR, fields and split differ; no transfer of reported scores, split or loss.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None. The present deterministic grouped-statistics factorial comes from accessible local models.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No generated query probes, sequence-field bridge or packed multiview attention is added. Replacement controls here concern evidence representation, not a QueryFormer reproduction.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Reconsider only after a local matched-query contrast identifies a consequential retrieval bottleneck under this frozen protocol.
